headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while the larger players saw modest revenue increases.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS delivered double‑digit growth supported by AI‑driven deals. Infosys and Wipro showed the weakest top‑line momentum, with Infosys cutting its FY27 revenue outlook and Wipro posting a profit decline. Overall, AI contributions were highlighted across several companies, but margin pressure persisted for some.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Infosys, HCLTech, TCS and Mphasis all reported AI‑related revenue growth or deal wins, indicating AI is becoming a core growth engine.

themes.title: Margin guidance upgrades
themes.detail: Coforge raised its FY27 EBIT margin target to 16%, reflecting confidence in higher‑margin AI and engineering services.

themes.title: Deal wins and contract wins
themes.detail: Infosys secured $5.2 bn of deals and TCS logged $9.6 bn of wins, showing continued demand for large‑scale transformation projects.
